The urease test is used to determine the ability of an organism to split urea, through the production of the enzyme urease. Urea is the product of decarboxylation of amino acids. Rapid urease-positive organisms turn the entire medium pink within 24 hours. Weakly positive organisms may take several days, and negative organisms produce no color change or yellow as a result of acid production.
